notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for standard connection and callback-service boundaries. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and federation identity. It verifies all standard connect overloads, callback-model validation, duplicate-connect rejection, pre-connect service failures, callback enable/disable and evocation, disconnect, and reconnect without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, transport, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador connect overloads, callback controls, pre-connect service boundaries, disconnect, and reconnect with ConfigurationResult and FederateAmbassador callback services
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador connection and callback-control declarations
